newsitem.title: USA: California Microwave sees first quarter loss.
newsitem.headline: California Microwave sees first quarter loss.

text.p: California Microwave Inc. said Monday it expected to report a loss "in the vicinity" of 15 cents per share in the fiscal 1997 first quarter ending Sept. 30.
In the year-ago first quarter, the company earned $5.1 million, or 31 cents per share, on sales of $115.8 million.

The wireless and satellite communications equipment company cited lower than planned levels of bookings and sales, the delay of certain large satellite communications orders, and product pricing pressures for the loss.
But it said it expected new orders booked for the quarter "to meet or exceed" the $91 million reported in the fiscal 1996 fourth quarter.

The company, the No. 1 U.S. supplier of microwave radios and telecommunications satellite earth stations used in wireless communications, said orders in the satellite communications area are "weak" this quarter but orders for wireless communications products "are improving." It said it will report results on Oct. 16.
The company's forecast of a 15 cents per share loss compares with analysts' consensus forecast of a 12 cents per share profit in the first quarter, according to First Call.
